description: We are NOVASTRA, a passionate and creative team taking part in NASA Space Apps Challenge. Our project, Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, aims to inspire young explorers through fun, interactive, and educational space missions. We believe that learning about space should be exciting and accessible to everyone. We are looking for enthusiastic members interested in space exploration, coding, game development, graphic design, science, and teamwork. Together, we aim to turn curiosity into discovery!
summary: Project NOVASTRA is an innovative space-exploration and data-driven solution designed to make complex astronomical data accessible and engaging for students and space enthusiasts. By leveraging official NASA resources and modern web technologies, NOVASTRA provides interactive tools that simplify space science concepts, track planetary missions, and foster a deeper understanding of our solar system. The project addresses the challenge of science communication by bridging the gap between raw scientific data and public accessibility, making it an essential educational tool for inspiring the next generation of space explorers.
details:
What does it do & how does it work? NOVASTRA functions as an interactive platform that integrates real-time data and educational resources regarding space exploration and solar system missions. It processes and visualizes astronomical concepts to make them easy to explore.
Benefits & Impact: It empowers students, educators, and space enthusiasts by providing a centralized hub for space science education, fostering curiosity, and encouraging STEM learning.
Tools, Coding Languages, and Software: Developed using web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and integrated with official NASA open APIs and educational databases (such as NASA Space Place, Solar System Exploration, and ESA resources).
Creativity & Factors Considered: The project focuses on user-centric design, seamless navigation, and accurate scientific representation to ensure an engaging and informative learning experience.
